The median is chosen over the mean to prevent outliers like two releases in the same week or an unexpectedly long hiatus from skewing results. Series with only one release are explicitly not predicted. The author himself admits that prediction is weak when data points are scarce — a forecast like "GPT OSS releases in late 2027" is more of a playful extrapolation than a reliable judgment. Extrapolating a nonlinearly developing field like AI from historical cadence is, in essence, like marking a boat to find a dropped sword.
